name: 43220 · Columbus, OH
findings: ZIP 43220 (Columbus) has 223 nonprofit organizations. 86 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 71 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 43220 (Columbus) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
